description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractFixture' used for creating database fixture files in a PHPUnit testing context for the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for managing a TextHelperService, retrieving the Doctrine EntityManager, and dumping fixture data to YAML files.

classes.name: AbstractFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating PHPUnit database fixtures, providing utility methods for managing helper services and exporting fixture content to files.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of TextHelperService.

methods.name: dumpFixture
methods.description: Dumps the fixture's content to a YAML file in the fixtures directory after verifying the database connection is valid.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the fixture data as an array.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Abstract static method that should return the filename for the fixture.
